name: Cheapest melamine price range inquiry
description: Tests price lookup when the customer asks about the cheapest melamine option. The AI should query the hds_prices table for melamine products and return the lowest-priced option with its real product name and price.

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a price with R prefix
Reply should reference melamine in the product name

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply

notes: Tests the AI's ability to handle comparative/range queries. The AI should look up melamine products and identify the cheapest option from the hds_prices table. It should return the actual lowest-priced melamine product name and its price, not a fabricated range.
